SINGLEPLAYERCARD-DEMONIC_SHIELD_SOLO.des: Lose 1 HP. Gain Block equal to the HP you have lost this combat.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-TANK_SOLO.title: Tank
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-TANK_SOLO.description: Take 50% more damage from enemies. Reflect all blocked Attack damage back at the attacker.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-MIDNIGHT_SOLO.title: Midnight
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-MIDNIGHT_SOLO.descripti:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Costs 1 less for each card in your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
Costs 2 less this turn for each card [gold]Exhausted[/gold] this turn.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-BLAZE_SOLO.title: Blaze
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-BLAZE_SOLO.description: Gain {Strength:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold] for each card you have discarded this turn.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-OUTRAGE_SOLO.title: Outrage
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-OUTRAGE_SOLO.descriptio:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Add a copy of this card to your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] for itself, plus one more for each other copy of this card in your hand.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-PINCER_ATTACK_SOLO.desc: This turn, the enemy takes double damage from Attack cards not currently in your hand.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-STEALTH_SOLO.title: Stealth
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-STEALTH_SOLO.descriptio: [gold]Sly.[/gold] Whenever you deal damage by means other than an Attack card, gain {StealthPowerSolo:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-BLADE_SYMPHONY_SOLO.des: Play every [gold]Shiv[/gold] in your Discard Pile or Exhaust Pile (Upgraded).
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-CONCOCT_SOLO.title: Concoct
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-CONCOCT_SOLO.descriptio: Give all un-enchanted Attack cards in your hand [gold]Venomous {Venomous:diff()}[/gold].
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-SHADOW_VANISH_SOLO.desc: [gold]Retain.[/gold] This turn, gain Dexterity equal to the number of non-Skill cards in your hand.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-HAMMER_TIME_SOLO.title: Hammer Time
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-HAMMER_TIME_SOLO.descri: Whenever you play [gold]Sovereign Blade[/gold], replay every card that [gold]Forged[/gold] this turn.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-GENEROUS_GIFT_SOLO.desc: At the start of your next turn, add 1 random{IfUpgraded:show: [gold]Upgraded[/gold]} Colorless card to your hand.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-SCHEME_SOLO.title: Scheme
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-CONSTELLATION_SOLO.desc: At the start of your next turn, draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}, and gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-TUTOR_SOLO.title: Tutor
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-TUTOR_SOLO.description: Choose a card in your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] to add to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-BONE_LEGION_SOLO.title: Bone Legion
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-GLIMPSE_BEYOND_SOLO.des: At the start of your next {IfUpgraded:show:3|2} turns, add a [gold]Soul[/gold] to your hand.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-UNDERWORLD_SOLO.title: Underworld
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-UNDERWORLD_SOLO.descrip: This turn, whenever you apply [gold]Doom[/gold], deal damage equal to that amount.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-CACOPHONY_SOLO.title: Cacophony
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-CACOPHONY_SOLO.descript: Every {Cards:diff()} cards drawn, deal {Damage:diff()} damage to a random enemy.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-ENERGY_SURGE_SOLO.title: Energy Surge
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-ENERGY_SURGE_SOLO.descr: At the start of each of your next {IfUpgraded:show:3|2} turns, gain 1 {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-IGNITION_SOLO.title: Ignition
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-IGNITION_SOLO.descripti: [gold]Channel[/gold] [gold]Plasma[/gold]. Trigger the Passive of all [gold]Plasma[/gold] orbs.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-HIBERNATE_SOLO.title: Hibernate
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-HIBERNATE_SOLO.descript:
This turn, your [gold]Frost[/gold] triggers its Passive twice.
[gold]Channel[/gold] {Repeat:diff()} [gold]Frost[/gold].
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-ONE_FOR_ALL_SOLO.title: One for All
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-IMITATION_LEARNING_SOLO: At the end of each of your next {IfUpgraded:show:3|2} turns, play a copy of the last Power you played.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-GANG_UP_SOLO.title: Gang Up
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-GANG_UP_SOLO.descriptio:
Deal 10 damage.
Replay every other Attack card you have played on this enemy this turn.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-TAG_TEAM_SOLO.title: Tag Team
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-TAG_TEAM_SOLO.descripti:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
The next Attack you play on the enemy is played an extra time.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-KNOCKDOWN_SOLO.title: Knockdown
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-KNOCKDOWN_SOLO.descript:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Next turn, the enemy takes {IfUpgraded:show:triple|double} damage.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-THE_BALL_SOLO.title: The Ball
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-THE_BALL_SOLO.descripti:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Increase this card's damage by {Increase:diff()} this combat and shuffle it into a random spot in your Draw Pile, Hand, or Discard Pile.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-BELIEVE_IN_YOU_SOLO.des: Next turn, once you have played an Attack, a Skill, and a Power, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-INTERCEPT_SOLO.title: Intercept
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-WAR_COUNCIL_SOLO.title: War Council
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-WAR_COUNCIL_SOLO.descri: Draw 2 cards. At the start of your next turn, draw 2 more cards.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-HELPING_HAND_SOLO.title: Helping Hand
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-HELPING_HAND_SOLO.descr: Double the Block gained from your next card.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-COORDINATE_SOLO.title: Coordinate
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-COORDINATE_SOLO.descrip: This turn, gain Strength equal to the number of cards in your hand.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-MIMICRY_SOLO.title: Mimicry
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-MIMICRY_SOLO.descriptio: Gain Block equal to the highest Block value among cards in your hand.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-GATHER_SOLO.title: Gather
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-GATHER_SOLO.description: Gain Block equal to the sum of the Block values of all other cards in your hand.
SINGLEPLAYERCARD-BEACON_OF_HOPE_SOLO.des: [gold]Innate.[/gold] At the end of your turn, gain half the [gold]Block[/gold] you gained that turn at the start of your next turn.
